title: Tamsin and the Typewriter
author: Coral Okonkwo
blurb: Beatrix Eastwick, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the ice breaks on the river.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
